question: Can the exact v3 physical image world be reprojected into local connected candidate-mark carriers whose frozen white-paint topology is non-degenerate, without using writing-system context or changing the v2 operation classifier?

projection.atomicCandidate: each surviving 8-connected foreground component after adaptive local thresholding
projection.candidateCapRule: deterministic spatially balanced selection by 4x4 grid, then descending skeleton pixels, then x/y order

classifier.closure: literal enclosed background component within candidate mask

nuisanceStability.comparison: candidate-level class distributions are compared at object level after exact image-hash verification; no system labels are used

successGates.sourceCoverage: at least 30 of 37 exact v3 objects yield at least 8 accepted candidate marks
successGates.candidateCount: at least 500 primary-threshold candidates after per-object cap
successGates.operationBreadth: at least 4 of persist/turn/branch/cross/close/loop_continue each occur in at least 25 candidates across at least 12 independent source objects
successGates.dominance: no single operation supplies more than 70% of non-other primary candidates
successGates.closureBalance: both open and closed candidates each supply at least 5% of primary candidates and occur in at least 12 source objects
successGates.relationBalance: among relation-eligible primary candidates, near-terminal and interior each supply at least 5% and occur in at least 8 source objects
successGates.thresholdStability: mean object-level Jensen-Shannon divergence of the seven-operation distribution between primary 0.65 and each nuisance variant is <=0.20

interpretation.pass: The physical representation is sufficiently non-degenerate and threshold-stable to justify rerunning white-paint transfer hypotheses on candidate-mark carriers in a separate experiment.
interpretation.fail: The candidate-mark representation remains collapsed or unstable; no white-paint historical inference is authorized and a new representation must be preregistered.

claimBoundary.allowed: A purely blind measurement statement about whether the same exact physical images can be projected into non-degenerate connected candidate-mark carriers.
forbidden: treating v3 P3/P5 as confirmed because v4 passes
changing the v2 classifier after viewing system context
